best_idea: Crossfade two music slots on a fixed-length clock with a linear level split (outgoing from 100 to 0, incoming from 0 to 100), then swap the slots so the live track always sits in the same slot, and drive the clock from game time that pauses with the game.
decision_why: Zone bed changes at a border need exactly this shape (two beds, one fade length, one swap), and the client only reads state; the fade clock must pause while frozen and the curve should be equal-power, so the idea is kept and the two defects are fixed.
acceptance: Walking from the forest bed into the swamp bed fades one out and the other in over the zone's crossfade length, and a menu opened mid-fade and closed resumes the same fade with no jump; a client test asserts levels 100/0 at start and that a 10 s freeze at the midpoint leaves the midpoint unchanged on resume.
